requirement: Converting an already-upgraded record leaves the file unchanged.
rationale:
The requirement has one obligation: converting an already-upgraded record leaves the file unchanged.

The test `src/evidence_format.rs#mod[tests]/fn[loading_is_read_only_and_conversion_is_in_place_idempotent_and_preserves_failures]` is marked `{test}` for this requirement. It covers the obligation as follows:
- It writes a legacy record, then runs `convert_file` once. It asserts `after != before`, which shows the record was really upgraded.
- It then runs `convert_file` a second time on the upgraded record. It asserts the bytes are identical to `after`, and that the file's modified time is unchanged, so the file was not rewritten.

The assertions check the exact outcome the requirement states. The requirement names no other input class, boundary or failure case. The malformed-file and load checks in the same test belong to other requirements.
